claim_one_line: THE ROOM-THREE CIRCLES (NEGATIVE, run as sealed; read out once 2026-10-14 19:04:39Z). A THREAD result (one cover of one thread, m003; THE WEAVE rule), sealed and run at the owner's ruling of 2026-10-14, 'Seal and run it, labelled'. On N_45 the room-three characters lie on five circles of cusp-trivial characters, one tau-orbit. At the 84 points of the circle through chi0 of orders 3, 5, 6, 8, 10, 12, 15, 20, 24, 30, 40 and 60 (b0 = 0, room exactly three; sm:B1547's Corollary 1 and Lemma G verbatim), every member has one distinct stratum, the interior one, and its generic class reads (0, -5) in both routes at every order (168 tasks, 252 stratum readings per route, 168 load-bearing checks): the least I(W1) is 0, with no (-3, -3) and no generation shape. The boundary Massey rank at the interior classes is zero (s - k = 0 at every reading; three needs 3), while t - k = 5. The four order-8 points read (0, -5), as sm:B1547 banked them. So no class at any point of these orders of the five circles carries three, in either order. All ten predictions as the priors leaned (9.03 expected). 0 of 19.
